title: Manali, Sissu & Kasol (3N/4D)
reportingPoint: Departure is in the evening from Delhi. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed. Pickup from Chandigarh is also available.
highlights: Hadimba temple, Old Manali and Mall Road
Solang Valley, Sissu and Atal Tunnel

Manikaran Sahib gurudwara and its hot water spring
Bonfire and music nights in Manali and Kasol
overview:
Manali, Sissu and Kasol in one trip: this **3 Nights / 4 Days** group trip leaves Delhi or Chandigarh in the evening. The group assembles at the pickup point, meets the team captains for a short briefing and travels overnight to Manali.

Day 1 covers Hadimba temple, Old Manali and Mall Road, with dinner by a bonfire at the hotel. Day 2 is Solang Valley, Sissu and Atal Tunnel. Day 3 drives to Kasol via Kullu for another bonfire dinner. Day 4 covers the Kasol market and cafes, Chalal village and the Manikaran Sahib gurudwara before the evening departure. Two nights in a Manali hotel, one night in Kasol, six meals and a trip captain are included. Prices start at ₹8,999 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).
